audience: rota and attendance managers who plan shifts and check worked hours and absences in StaffSavvy

useCases.title: See who is on shift at a venue
useCases.text: List the shifts for a date range, with the staff account, group and venue of each shift. List the venues and groups to match their names.

useCases.title: Review worked hours for a group
useCases.text: List the recorded time entries since a date, filtered by group or another field. Each entry shows its start, end, venue and pay element.

useCases.title: Check the absences booked for a month
useCases.text: List the absence periods with their dates. Read the absence types to name each one, such as holiday or sickness.

useCases.title: Look up one shift by its id
useCases.text: Check the connection with the version call. Then read one shift by its numeric id.

useCases.title: List staff accounts and their levels
useCases.text: List staff accounts with names, contact details and levels. The results include personal data about staff, so share them only with people who need them.
